title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Policy: Decisions, Denial Reasons, the Award Window and Withdrawal
content:
## Decision and letter

A complete application under the Patient Financial Assistance Program is decided within the tier's decision time of business days, and the decision letter goes out within the tier's decision-letter time of business days.

## Approval and denial

An application is approved only at a tier whose conditions the documented facts meet. It is denied:

| Denial reason | When it applies |
|---|---|
| Income above program limit | No tier applies |
| Documentation not received | Under the documentation rule |
| Balances not eligible | The patient has no invoice the award could discount |

## The award window

On approval the award covers dates of service from the award start date through the award end date.

- **Award start date**: the application date minus the tier's lookback of calendar days.
- **Award end date**: the application date plus the tier's award term of calendar months; when the month reached has no day of that number, the end date is the last day of that month.
- Later dates of service are covered only where the tier covers dates of service after the application date.

### Worked dates (hypothetical applications)

| Application date | Lookback (days) | Award term (months) | Award start date | Award end date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2026 | 240 | 12 | 18 July 2025 | 15 March 2027 |
| 15 March 2026 | 365 | 12 | 15 March 2025 | 15 March 2027 |
| 31 August 2026 | 240 | 6 | 3 January 2026 | 28 February 2027 |

In the third row, February 2027 has no 31st day, so the award ends on the last day of February.

A date of service on the award start date or on the award end date lies inside the window; a date of service the day before the start date lies outside it.

## Withdrawal

An application can be withdrawn only by the applicant personally, never by an agent on the applicant's behalf. A withdrawal rests on the applicant's own statement that they withdraw the application they identify.
